title: BSC wallet candidate screening v0.1
objective: Profile the BSC master first, then create evidence-scoped BSC scene eligibility and candidate research packs. Keep behavior signals, risk overlays, evidence confidence, and unknowns separate; do not copy Solana thresholds or issue smart-money/follow/heavy-position labels.
forbidden_actions: Do not execute real trades, sign transactions, broadcast transactions, or connect a trading wallet.
Do not read seed phrases, private keys, browser cookies, login sessions, DPAPI material, or trading API keys.
Do not automate a logged-in GMGN page; only consume user-provided offline exports from the private root.
Do not commit wallet addresses, transaction hashes, raw GMGN exports, chainfm_out contents, or private manifests containing raw records.
Do not treat null, unknown, or missing values as zero.
Do not create a cross-chain global wallet score or assume SOL and BSC addresses identify the same entity.
Do not squash, rebase, rewrite pushed history, push to main, or merge a PR.
Do not generate a global score, forced Pxx with insufficient peers, or direct follow conclusions.
acceptance_commands: MUST IMPLEMENT AND EXECUTE before DONE: tsx src/cli/run-bsc-wallet-candidate-screening-v0-1.ts --private-root "$CHAINFM_OUT_DIR" --input-manifest "$CHAINFM_OUT_DIR/bsc/bsc_wallet_cleaning_manifest.json" --output-private "$CHAINFM_OUT_DIR/bsc/bsc_wallet_candidates_v0_1/"; use authorized real private input, run twice with identical input, verify input/output record counts and identical output SHA-256, write replay_manifest.json and source_hashes.json, and verify chainfm_out is not tracked by Git.
